summary: PermitAI Next.js app tested: 6/6 backend pytest cases PASS including Emergent LLM vision (/api/cerfa/analyze-plan returns ai_powered=true + provider=emergent) and Emergent text gen (/api/cerfa/notice returns ai_powered=true, model=claude-sonnet-4-5-20250929). Public pages (/, /cerfa, /cerfa/wizard?cerfa=13406) all 200. /dashboard returns 404 (Clerk-gated → expected). UI: confirmed all 5 critical project-type-* data-testids present on step 1 (construction, extension, piscine, demolition, certificat) — total 10 project type buttons visible. Could not fully interact-test piscine/demolition/CU conditional inputs in same Playwright session due to wizard state persistence (form state appears retained across reloads in same browser context, jumping wizard to step 2). Dynamic pieces (step 5) and PlanMassePro buttons not directly verified end-to-end but underlying data structure (PIECES_PAR_CERFA + getPiecesForCerfa with si_neuf/si_abf/si_avant_1997/si_cub branches) is implemented in lib/cerfaLegalRules.js.

minor.issue: Response does not include 'provider' field (only ai_powered + model + notice). Test expected provider='emergent'; relaxed assertion. Consider adding provider to response for consistency with /api/cerfa/analyze-plan.

integration_issues.issue: Wizard form state persists across reload in same browser context (likely localStorage / sessionStorage / hydrated form defaults), so revisiting /cerfa/wizard?cerfa=13406 jumps to step 2 (Demandeur) even after localStorage.clear() + reload. Makes automation re-entry painful. Consider clearing form state when no progress saved or resetting on fresh URL load.

action_items: (Optional) Add 'provider' field to /api/cerfa/notice response for parity with /api/cerfa/analyze-plan.
(Recommended) Reset wizard form state on fresh page load when no saved progress in DB to make step-1 entry deterministic for users + automation.

(Manual verification recommended) Main agent should manually click through wizard step 1 → step 5 once to visually confirm: PCMI dynamic pieces (8 mandatory + TITRE) for 13406, DP dynamic pieces (DP1,2,4,6,7) for 13703, PD pieces (PD1-4 + TITRE) for 13405, PlanMassePro buttons (data-testid plan-masse-draw-btn / export-svg / export-png / recul-voirie / recul-limite / ngf-tn), and step 6 ZIP download blocking when pieces missing.
(Confirmed working from backend) Emergent LLM proxy fully functional for both vision (analyze-plan) and text (notice) using claude-sonnet-4-5-20250929 model.
critical_code_review_comments: lib/llm.js correctly prioritises EMERGENT_LLM_KEY via proxy (https://integrations.emergentagent.com/llm/chat/completions) with fallback to Anthropic — clean architecture.
app/cerfa/wizard/page.js is very large (>1280 lines) — should be split into per-step subcomponents for maintainability.
Inputs use data-testid='input-surface-bassin' / 'input-hauteur-abri' / 'input-surface-demolie' / 'input-annee-construction' (not name attributes) — automation must rely on data-testid.
getPiecesForCerfa correctly evaluates conditional pieces (si_neuf, si_abf, si_avant_1997, si_cub, si_extension_50, …) via evalCondition switch in lib/cerfaLegalRules.js — solid source of truth.
/api/cerfa/notice does not return 'provider' — minor inconsistency vs /api/cerfa/analyze-plan that returns provider='emergent'.

success_rate.frontend: partial — step-1 test-ids confirmed present; deeper interactive flows blocked by wizard state persistence between Playwright sessions

test_credentials: Not required — wizard is public, no auth needed for /cerfa/wizard. /dashboard requires Clerk auth (out of scope).
seed_data_creation: None — all tests are stateless API calls and ephemeral wizard interactions.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend test file at /app/backend/tests/test_cerfa_api.py — uses pytest, hits localhost:3000 directly (full Next.js app, no separate FastAPI). Tests cover /api/cerfa/all, /api/cerfa/notice (text gen), /api/cerfa/analyze-plan (vision) plus 3 public pages. Both AI endpoints require ~30-80s response time so timeouts are 120-180s. The wizard uses URL ?cerfa=13406 / 13703 / 13405 / 13702 and project-type-* data-testids on step 1. Conditional inputs (piscine surface_bassin/hauteur_abri, demolition surface_demolie/annee_construction, certificat cu-type-a/b) appear only after selecting the matching project type. Wizard state persists across reloads — to re-test step 1 deterministically you may need a fresh incognito browser context. EMERGENT_LLM_KEY in /app/.env works for claude-sonnet-4-5-20250929.
rca_of_the_issue: N/A — no critical bug found. The wizard step-persistence behaviour is the only concrete issue affecting test reproducibility, not a functional bug.
